text:
rachel ng: Hi team — split bill question. I paid for a client dinner last night on my personal card, total $246. Restaurant only gave one receipt showing the total. Client covered 50% verbally but I need to submit for reimbursement for my share ($123) and request the client invoice for the other half. What docs do you need?
tom (manager): Confirmed client covered half. Rachel, can you mark the attendees and confirm client name for accounting? I'll approve once posted.
rachel ng: attendees: me, tom, and client rep Aya Suzuki (Acme Labs). Meal was business development. Attached single receipt photo.
expense-bot: Reminder: For split charges, finance requires either an itemized receipt showing per-person amounts OR a manager note approving split and client invoice / PO.
nina (finance): Thanks Rachel. Two options: (A) If you can get an itemized folio showing Aya's items, upload and we'll reimburse $123; (B) If not, Tom's manager approval + client confirmation email (or note from sales) will work but we'll need a signed client invoice or copy of email stating they covered 50% for audit. Also we need the merchant MCC and VAT details if you want VAT reclaim.
rachel ng: I can ask the restaurant for an itemized folio first thing. If they can't provide it, I'll ask Acme for a quick note. How fast does reimbursement go after docs?
nina (finance): Once we have either itemized folio or client confirmation + Tom's approval in thread, we can do standard reimbursement (3-5 business days). If you need faster, request a small advance and provide the docs within 5 days.
tom (manager): Approving split now for reimbursement contingent on docs. I approve Rachel's $123 reimbursement.
rachel ng: thanks — I messaged the restaurant: they said they can email an itemized folio within 24hrs. Uploading here when it arrives.
expense-bot: Thread flagged: SPLIT_BILL. Please attach itemized folio or client confirmation within 7 days to avoid audit hold.
rachel ng: uploaded itemized_folio.jpg to Expensify under "dinner-acme-03-21" — shows line items and Aya's main course.
nina (finance): Received. Itemized folio looks sufficient. Approving reimbursement of $123. Payout queued under FIN-9012. Expected settlement 3 business days. We'll also capture VAT details for reclaim.
rachel ng: incredible, thank you both.
